entities.summary: The Mittellandlinie is a railway route in Switzerland. It runs from Olten via Bern and Fribourg to Lausanne. Mittellandlinie is a railway line from Europe. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
